label: ZKN_LETSGO_001_000
text:
It can go for days without eating a single morsel.
In the bulb on its back, it stores energy.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_002_000
text:
The bud on its back grows by drawing energy. It
gives off an aroma when it is ready to bloom.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_003_000
text:
The flower on its back catches the sun’s rays.
The sunlight is then absorbed and
used for energy.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_004_000
text:
The flame at the tip of its tail makes a sound as
it burns. You can only hear it in quiet places.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_005_000
text:
Tough fights could excite this Pokémon. When
excited, it may breathe out bluish-white flames.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_006_000
text:
When this Pokémon expels a blast of superhot
fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns
more intensely.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_007_000
text:
Shoots water at prey while in the water.
Withdraws into its shell when in danger.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_008_000
text:
When tapped on its head, this Pokémon will pull
it in, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_009_000
text:
Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out
water with even more force than a fire hose.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_010_000
text:
If you touch the feeler on top of its head, it will
release a horrible stink to protect itself.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_011_000
text:
Hardens its shell to protect itself. However, a
large impact may cause it to pop out of its shell.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_012_000
text:
Its wings, covered with poisonous powder, repel
water. This allows it to fly in the rain.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_013_000
text:
Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides
in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_014_000
text:
Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it
may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_015_000
text:
It has three poisonous stingers on its
forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab
its enemy repeatedly.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_016_000
text:
Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up
sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_017_000
text:
This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies
around its large territory in search of prey.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_018_000
text:
This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed,
seeking prey. Its large talons are feared
as wicked weapons.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_019_000
text:
Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you
see one, you can be certain that 40 more
live in the area.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_020_000
text:
Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers,
so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_021_000
text:
Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around
very fast to protect its territory.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_022_000
text:
A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it
senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_023_000
text:
The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it
wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_024_000
text:
The frightening patterns on its belly have been
studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_025_000
text:
This forest-dwelling Pokémon stores electricity
in its cheeks, so you’ll feel a tingly shock
if you touch it.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_026_000
text:
When electricity builds up inside its body, it
becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_027_000
text:
Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its
hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_028_000
text:
It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws.
If broken, they start to grow back in a day.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_029_000
text:
A mild-mannered Pokémon that does not like
to fight. Beware—its small horn secretes venom.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_030_000
text:
When resting deep in its burrow, its barbs always
retract. This is proof that it is relaxed.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_031_000
text:
Tough scales cover the sturdy body of
this Pokémon. It appears that the scales
grow in cycles.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_032_000
text:
Its large ears are always kept upright. If it senses
danger, it will attack with a poisonous sting.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_033_000
text:
Its horn contains venom. If it stabs an
enemy with the horn, the impact makes
the poison leak out.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_034_000
text:
Its steel-like hide adds to its powerful tackle.
Its horns are so hard, they can pierce a diamond.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_035_000
text:
Adored for their cute looks and playfulness.
They are thought to be rare, as they
do not appear often.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_036_000
text:
They appear to be very protective of their own
world. It is a kind of fairy, rarely seen by people.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_037_000
text:
Both its fur and its tails are beautiful.
As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_038_000
text:
According to an enduring legend, nine noble
saints were united and reincarnated
as this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_039_000
text:
Uses its cute round eyes to enrapture its foe.
It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls
the foe to sleep.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_040_000
text:
Its body is very elastic. By inhaling deeply,
it can continue to inflate itself without limit.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_041_000
text:
Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as
a sonar used to check for objects in its way.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_042_000
text:
It attacks in a stealthy manner,
without warning. Its sharp fangs
are used to bite and to suck blood.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_043_000
text:
It may be mistaken for a clump of weeds.
If you try to yank it out of the ground,
it shrieks horribly.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_044_000
text:
Smells incredibly foul! However, around one
out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing
its nose-bending stink.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_045_000
text:
Flaps its broad flower petals to scatter
its poisonous pollen. The flapping sound
is very loud.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_046_000
text:
Burrows under the ground to gnaw on
tree roots. The mushrooms on its back
absorb most of the nutrition.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_047_000
text:
The bug host is drained of energy by
the mushroom on its back. The mushroom
appears to do all the thinking.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_048_000
text:
Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you
can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_049_000
text:
The powdery scales on its wings are hard to
remove from skin. They also contain poison
that leaks out on contact.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_050_000
text:
It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time
underground, though it may pop up in caves.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_051_000
text:
A team of triplets that can burrow to a depth
of 60 miles. It’s reported that this triggers
an earthquake.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_052_000
text:
Appears to be more active at night. It loves
round and shiny things. It can’t stop itself from
picking them up.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_053_000
text:
The gem in its forehead glows on its own!
It walks with all the grace and elegance
of a proud queen.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_054_000
text:
Always tormented by headaches. It uses
psychic powers, but whether it intends to
do so is not known.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_055_000
text:
Its long, slim limbs end in broad flippers.
They are used for swimming gracefully in lakes.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_056_000
text:
An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers
easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_057_000
text:
It stops being angry only when nobody else
is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_058_000
text:
A Pokémon with a friendly nature.
However, it will bark fiercely at
anything invading its territory.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_059_000
text:
A legendary Pokémon in the East. Many people
are charmed by the grace and beauty of
its running.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_060_000
text:
The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by
area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_061_000
text:
Under attack, it uses its belly spiral to put
the foe to sleep. It then makes its escape.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_062_000
text:
Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its
body. It can even overtake world-class swimmers.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_063_000
text:
Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger,
it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_064_000
text:
Many odd things happen if this Pokémon is
close by. For example, it makes clocks
run backward.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_065_000
text:
A Pokémon that can memorize anything.
It never forgets what it learns—that’s why
this Pokémon is smart.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_066_000
text:
Very powerful in spite of its small size.
Its mastery of many types of martial arts
makes it very tough.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_067_000
text:
The belt around its waist holds back its energy.
Without it, this Pokémon would be unstoppable.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_068_000
text:
One arm alone can move mountains.
Using all four arms, this Pokémon
fires off awesome punches.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_069_000
text:
Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares
tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_070_000
text:
When hungry, it swallows anything that moves.
Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_071_000
text:
Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey.
Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day,
bones and all.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_072_000
text:
It can sometimes be found all dry and
shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back
into the sea to revive it.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_073_000
text:
Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely.
They wrap around prey and weaken it
with poison.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_074_000
text:
Commonly found near mountain trails and
the like. If you step on one by accident,
it gets angry.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_075_000
text:
Often seen rolling down mountain trails.
Obstacles are just things to roll straight over,
not avoid.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_076_000
text:
Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender
and whitish. Its hide hardens when it’s
exposed to air.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_077_000
text:
Capable of jumping incredibly high.
Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb
the impact of a hard landing.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_078_000
text:
Just loves to run. If it sees something faster
than itself, it will give chase at top speed.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_079_000
text:
Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content
to loll about without worrying about the time.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_080_000
text:
Lives lazily by the sea. If the Shellder on its tail
comes off, it becomes a Slowpoke again.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_081_000
text:
It is hatched with the ability to defy gravity.
It floats while emitting powerful
electromagnetic waves.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_082_000
text:
Generates strange radio signals. It raises
the temperature by 3.6 degrees Fahrenheit
within 3,300 feet.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_083_000
text:
They live where reedy plants grow.
Farfetch’d are rarely seen, so it’s thought
their numbers are decreasing.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_084_000
text:
Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this
Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_085_000
text:
One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form
a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph
in prairies.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_086_000
text:
Loves freezing-cold conditions.
Relishes swimming in a frigid climate
of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_087_000
text:
Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by
even intense cold, it swims powerfully
in icy waters.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_088_000
text:
Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid
to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_089_000
text:
Smells so awful, it can cause fainting.
Through degeneration of its nose,
it lost its sense of smell.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_090_000
text:
The shell can withstand any attack. However,
when it is open, the tender body is exposed.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_091_000
text:
For protection, it uses its harder-than-diamond
shell. It also shoots spikes from the shell.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_092_000
text:
Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings.
It has no real shape, as it appears to be
made of a gas.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_093_000
text:
By licking, it saps the victim’s life. It causes
shaking that won’t stop until the victim’s demise.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_094_000
text:
A Gengar is close by if you feel a sudden chill.
It may be trying to lay a curse on you.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_095_000
text:
Burrows at high speed in search of food.
The tunnels it leaves are used as homes
by Diglett.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_096_000
text:
If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes
show you dreams it had eaten in the past.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_097_000
text:
Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will
try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_098_000
text:
Its pincers are superb weapons. They sometimes
break off during battle, but they grow back fast.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_099_000
text:
One claw grew massively and is as hard as steel.
It has 10,000-horsepower strength.
However, it is too heavy.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_100_000
text:
It is said to camouflage itself as a Poké Ball.
It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_101_000
text:
Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the
slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_102_000
text:
The heads attract each other and spin
around. There must be six heads for it to
maintain balance.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_103_000
text:
Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of
the three heads thinks about whatever it likes.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_104_000
text:
Wears the skull of its deceased mother.
Its cries echo inside the skull and
come out as a sad melody.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_105_000
text:
Small and weak, this Pokémon is adept
with its bone club. It has grown more vicious
over the ages.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_106_000
text:
When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard
as a diamond on impact and destroys its enemy.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_107_000
text:
Punches in corkscrew fashion. It can punch
its way through a concrete wall like a drill.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_108_000
text:
Its tongue spans almost seven feet and moves
more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can
cause paralysis.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_109_000
text:
In hot places, its internal gases could
expand and explode without any warning.
Be very careful!

label: ZKN_LETSGO_110_000
text:
This Pokémon lives and grows by absorbing
poison gas, dust, and germs that exist
inside garbage.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_111_000
text:
A Pokémon with a one-track mind. Once it
charges, it won’t stop running until it falls asleep.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_112_000
text:
Its brain developed when it began walking on
its hind legs. Its armor-like hide even repels
molten lava.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_113_000
text:
A gentle and kindhearted Pokémon that shares
its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured Pokémon.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_114_000
text:
Its identity is obscured by masses of thick blue
vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_115_000
text:
Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won’t run
from any fight to keep its young protected.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_116_000
text:
If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray
water or a special type of ink from its mouth.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_117_000
text:
Touching the back fin causes numbness. It hooks
its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_118_000
text:
When it is time for them to lay eggs, they
can be seen swimming up rivers and falls
in large groups.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_119_000
text:
It is the male’s job to make a nest by carving out
boulders in a stream using the horn on its head.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_120_000
text:
As long as the center section is unharmed,
this Pokémon can grow back fully even if it is
chopped to bits.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_121_000
text:
The center section is named the core.
People think it is communicating when
it glows in seven colors.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_122_000
text:
Always practicing its pantomime act.
It makes enemies believe something exists
that really doesn’t.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_123_000
text:
Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its
scythes. The movement looks like that of a ninja.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_124_000
text:
Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it
were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_125_000
text:
If a major power outage occurs, it is certain
that this Pokémon has eaten electricity
at a power plant.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_126_000
text:
Born in an active volcano. Its body is
always cloaked in flames, so it looks like
a big ball of fire.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_127_000
text:
Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard!
It can’t move if it’s cold out, so it lives in
warm places.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_128_000
text:
A rowdy Pokémon with a lot of stamina.
Once running, it won’t stop until it
hits something.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_129_000
text:
Famous for being very unreliable. It can be
found swimming in seas, lakes, rivers,
and shallow puddles.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_130_000
text:
Brutally vicious and enormously destructive.
Known for totally destroying cities in
ancient times.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_131_000
text:
A gentle soul that can understand
human speech. It can ferry people across
the sea on its back.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_132_000
text:
When it spots an enemy, its body transfigures
into an almost-perfect copy of its opponent.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_133_000
text:
It can evolve into a variety of forms.
Eevee’s genes are the key to solving
the mysteries of Pokémon evolution.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_134_000
text:
Its cell structure is similar to water molecules.
It melts into the water and becomes invisible.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_135_000
text:
A sensitive Pokémon that easily becomes sad
or angry. Every time its mood changes, it
charges power.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_136_000
text:
It has a flame chamber inside its body. It inhales,
then breathes out fire that is over 3,000
degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_137_000
text:
The only Pokémon that people anticipate
can fly into space. None has managed
the feat yet, however.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_138_000
text:
An ancient Pokémon that was recovered from
a fossil. It swam by cleverly twisting its
10 tentacles about.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_139_000
text:
Its sharp beak rings its mouth. Its shell was too
big for it to move freely, so it became extinct.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_140_000
text:
A Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil.
It used the eyes on its back while hiding
on the seafloor.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_141_000
text:
A slim and fast swimmer. It sliced its prey with
its sharp sickles and drank the body fluids.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_142_000
text:
A savage Pokémon that died out in ancient
times. It was resurrected using DNA taken
from amber.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_143_000
text:
Will eat anything, even if the food happens to
be a little moldy. It never gets an upset stomach.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_144_000
text:
A legendary bird Pokémon. It freezes water
that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_145_000
text:
This legendary bird Pokémon is said to
appear when the sky turns dark and lightning
showers down.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_146_000
text:
A legendary bird Pokémon. As it flaps its
flaming wings, even the night sky will turn red.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_147_000
text:
Long thought to be a myth, this Pokémon’s
existence was only recently confirmed by a
fisherman who caught one.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_148_000
text:
According to a witness, its body was surrounded
by a strange aura that gave it a mystical look.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_149_000
text:
It is said that this Pokémon lives somewhere
in the sea and that it flies. However, these are
only rumors.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_150_000
text:
Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However,
its size and disposition are vastly different.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_151_000
text:
When viewed through a microscope, this
Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_808_000
text:
It melts particles of iron and other metals found
in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its
body of molten steel.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_809_000
text:
Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron
from nothing, for some reason it has come back
to life after 3,000 years.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_003_001
text:
In order to support its flower, which has grown
larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs
have become stronger.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_006_001
text:
The overwhelming power that fills its entire body
causes it to turn black and creates intense
blue flames.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_006_002
text:
Its bond with its Trainer is the source of
its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability
greater than that of a jet fighter.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_009_001
text:
The cannon on its back is as powerful as a
tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to
withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_015_001
text:
Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its
prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs,
dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_018_001
text:
With its muscular strength now greatly
increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks
without resting.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_019_001
text:
Its whiskers provide it with a keen sense of smell,
enabling it to pick up the scent of hidden food
and locate it instantly.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_020_001
text:
It makes its Rattata underlings gather food
for it, dining solely on the most nutritious
and delicious fare.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_026_001
text:
It loves pancakes prepared with a secret Alolan
recipe. Some wonder whether that recipe holds
the key to this Pokémon’s evolution.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_027_001
text:
Its ice-covered body lets it slide across the
ground with bullet-like speed, sending its
enemies flying when it hits them.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_028_001
text:
This is Sandslash’s form after adaptation to a
frigid environment. The cold air emitted by its
body sharpens its icy spikes.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_037_001
text:
It looks like snow come to life, and the breath
it exhales is −58 degrees Fahrenheit. Another
name for it is Keokeo.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_038_001
text:
It lives on mountains perpetually covered in
snow and is revered as a deity incarnate.
It appears draped in a blizzard.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_050_001
text:
After living in soil with high iron content for
some time, three steel whiskers sprouted from
the top of its head.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_051_001
text:
They’re referred to as triplets, but they’re not
identical—the metallic elements in their bodies
differ slightly. The proof shows in their whiskers!

label: ZKN_LETSGO_052_001
text:
Highly intelligent and prideful, it’s famously
difficult to handle—but that’s also a reason
for its popularity.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_053_001
text:
It has the classiest coat. The rippling of its fur
in the heat of battle has a beauty all its own.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_065_001
text:
It’s adept at precognition. When attacks
completely miss Alakazam, that’s because
it’s seeing the future.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_074_001
text:
Its stone head is imbued with electricity and
magnetism. If you carelessly step on one,
you’ll be in for a painful shock.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_075_001
text:
When it comes rolling down a mountain path,
anything in its way gets zapped by electricity
and sent flying.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_076_001
text:
It uses magnetism to accelerate and fire off rocks
tinged with electricity. Even if it doesn’t score
a direct hit, the jolt of electricity will do the job.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_080_001
text:
Under the influence of Shellder’s digestive
fluids, Slowpoke has awakened, gaining a great
deal of power—and a little motivation to boot.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_088_001
text:
It has a passion for trash above all else,
speedily digesting it and creating brilliant
crystals of sparkling poison.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_089_001
text:
Muk’s coloration becomes increasingly vivid
the more it feasts on its favorite dish—trash.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_094_001
text:
It can pass through other dimensions and appear
anywhere. It caused a stir one time when it stuck
just one leg out of a wall.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_103_001
text:
The strong sunlight of the Alola region has
awakened the power hidden within Exeggcute.
This is the result.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_105_001
text:
It has transformed the spirit of its dear departed
mother into flames, and tonight it will once
again dance in mourning of others of its kind.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_115_001
text:
Its child has grown rapidly, thanks to the energy
of Mega Evolution. Mother and child show off
their harmonious teamwork in battle.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_127_001
text:
With its vaunted horns, it can lift an
opponent 10 times heavier than itself
and fly about with ease.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_130_001
text:
Although it obeys its instinctive drive to destroy
everything within its reach, it will respond to
orders from a Trainer it truly trusts.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_142_001
text:
The power of Mega Evolution has completely
restored its genes. The rocks on its body are
harder than diamond.

label: ZKN_LETSGO_150_001
text:
Psychic power has augmented its muscles.
It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint
a hundred meters in two seconds flat!

label: ZKN_LETSGO_150_002
text:
Despite its diminished size, its mental power
has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought,
it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.
